title: Strategy’s STRC Hits $100 Par for First Time Since May After Over $2 Billion in Buybacks
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Strategy’s STRC Hits $100 Par for First Time Since May After Over $2 Billion in Buybacks Strategy’s STRC preferred hit $100 par on Wednesday for the first time since May, after billions in buybacks, a 12% dividend rate and a switch to daily payouts. This post Strategy’s STRC Hits $100 Par for First Time Since May After Over $2 Billion in Buybacks first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
